column1: # **Known gap, diagnosed 2026-09-12: the entry narration is not staged.**
# `karma.md` Section 12's entry table paces the sequence in world ticks - the
# approach record, the kneel record, then "After ten world ticks, record `29`:
# the question asking which virtue", then six ticks after a nonblank virtue
# answer and twelve after each nonblank mantra. This engine prints the whole
# entry inside the one key handler, so the `early` and `mid` beats - which
# sample during those pauses - show the original still on
# `tranquil Shrine...` while the engine is already asking the virtue.
# The text itself agrees; `shrine-flow` and `shrine-unfocused` both match
# because their beats fall outside the pauses. Closing this needs a
# timed-narration stage the runtime does not have yet - the endgame's
# per-frame operation queue is the nearest existing shape.
# The shrine entry narration, captured while it is still printing.
